extracted.name: Easy Bread Machine Challah
extracted.description: Challah, a yeasted egg bread, is made especially easy in a bread machine.
instruction_lines: Add milk, eggs, margarine, bread flour, white sugar, salt, and yeast to the bread machine pan in the order recommended by the manufacturer.
Select the Basic Bread cycle and Light Crust setting. Start the machine.
When the baking cycle is complete, carefully remove the loaf from the pan and transfer it to a wire rack. Let cool before slicing.
